verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own docs say marketers can set up simple workflows that automate actions after an email is sent, and the product page references nurture emails, so some first-party lifecycle automation exists. Nothing in the pack shows multi-step sequences, branching, delays or exit rules. missing for 10: documented multi-step workflow builder, branching logic, delay/wait steps, exit/unenrollment rules, welcome/onboarding/winback examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build multi-step lifecycle automations — welcome series, onboarding, winback — with branches, delays, and exit rules

citations.quote: You can set up simple workflows to automate actions after the email is sent.
Rewrite every nurture email for the specific contact receiving it, using their CRM data, behavior, and live company research.
